answer: An copycat running 84 aliases thus needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in echo, expire in copper, and quartz lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1046 identities would post 1427 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
